name: Euclid
summary: Space survey designed for the dark universe, using galaxy shapes and redshifts to trace dark-matter distribution and structure growth.
detection_principle: VIS measures precise optical shapes, while NISP supplies near-infrared photometry and spectroscopy; weak lensing and galaxy clustering reconstruct three-dimensional matter structure.

status.label: Operation supported by evidence
status.evidence: An ESA 2026 announcement reports science results from Euclid observations.

collaboration.name: Euclid collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Only examples of lead or participating institutions directly established by the sources are listed. This is not a complete collaboration list, and listing does not imply equal institutional roles.

results.summary: Jointly studies candidate very dark-matter-rich low-luminosity galaxies with Hubble and Subaru; does not identify particle species.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
